question: If (ab + bc + ca) = 0, then what is the value of ((1)/({{a²) - bc}} + (1)/({{b²) - ca}} + (1)/({{c²) - ab}})?

(ab + bc + ca) = 0

⇒ ab + ca = – bc ( equation 2 )
